results.quote: Theorem 5. _Given two sets A and B, each consisting of n points in the plane, and an integer K with_ \(1\le K\le n^2\)_, one can compute the K-th smallest distance among all interpoint distances between A and B in O(n_<sup>4/3</sup>) _deterministic time._

results.previous_best: O((m \log n + n \log m + m^{2/3} n^{2/3}) \log(m+n)) time (Wang and Zhao 2023)
results.quote: Theorem 6. _Given a set A of m points and a set B of n points in the plane, and an integer K with_ \(1\le K\le mn\)_, one can compute the K-th smallest distance among all interpoint distances between A and B in O(n_log<sup>2</sup>_m+m_log<sup>2</sup>_n+m_<sup>2/3</sup>_n_<sup>2/3</sup>) _deterministic time._
